neighbours.label: The word 'notwithstanding' and the piece 'stant' in Spanish 'no obstante'
fire: These problems notwithstanding, the plan went ahead.
The law applies notwithstanding any earlier contract.
The crowd stayed notwithstanding the heavy rain.
We finished on time, notwithstanding the delays.
And notwithstanding his age, he kept working.
La ley, no obstante, sigue vigente.
Fue caro, no obstante lo compramos.
quiet: Despite these problems, the plan went ahead.
The law applies regardless of any earlier contract.
The crowd stayed despite the heavy rain.
We finished on time, in spite of the delays.
And in spite of his age, he kept working.
La ley, sin embargo, sigue vigente.
Fue caro, aun así lo compramos.
